news.title: Recently Datamined Mounts Won’t Be Coming to WoW Forever
news.description: Community members recently datamined new Mounts in WoW Forever, but Blizzard warns that they are not intended for this game version.

news.title: Free WoW Forever Stress Test Day Postponed
news.description: Blizzard announced a delay for the upcoming free WoW Forever stress test, as it will now arrive two days later than planned.

news.title: Your Favorite Race Was Just Changed in WoW Forever
news.description: In their latest update, Blizzard removed the Weapon Specialization passives from every race in WoW Forever.

news.title: Racial and Class Tuning, New Features and Options: Massive WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, October 15th
news.description: We have a giant batch of development notes for the new Beta build, with tons of class and racial ability changes, item and quest improvements, and a whole lot more!

news.title: WoW Forever Free Stress Test Start Times and Details Revealed
news.description: The official stress test announcement and exact start times are here, so check out when you can try Forever out for free!

news.title: All 6 and 12-Month Subscription Rewards, Including New WoW Forever ones
news.description: Blizzard reveal the WoW Forever 6 and 12-month subscription rewards, as well as share all the goodies for all game versions!

news.title: Single Target Healing, Better Seal Twisting, More Thread and Survivability: WoW Forever Class Deep Dive, Paladin
news.description: The final entry in the class deep dive series is here and we have a long look at Paladins, with big changes to all three specs!

news.title: The PvP Episode – WoW: Forever Podcast Episode 4
news.description: PvP is the hot topic in this week's episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast. Nerfs and buffs to Honor gains, and a brand new dueling zone!
